candidates.change_summary: Replace 'msg.sender' with 'jojoTeam' in the EmergencyOracle constructor argument so the new oracle owner differs from the caller.
Assign the newly created oracle address to a state variable so repeated calls produce different observable state.
Replace 'msg.sender == jojoTeam' with 'true' to remove access control, allowing any caller to create an oracle, changing when the function succeeds.
Delete the require statement in onlyJojoTeam to remove the access check entirely.
